purpose: Data contract for real-project supervised model training. No model may be labelled real_project without verified project data and an explicit target.
rules: Target labels must come from verified project records; the engine must not manufacture labels.
project_id should be retained to enable project-aware validation when multiple projects are available.
Native P6/XER fields remain authoritative for formal schedule calculations.
Training data must not include post-outcome leakage fields that would not exist at inference time.

event_classification.description: Classify delay/change/project-control events from verified features/evidence.

delay_risk_prediction.description: Estimate verified activity/event delay-risk class or probability.

forecast_finish_deviation_prediction.description: Predict analytical deviation days; native CPM forecast remains governing.

resource_demand_prediction.description: Predict analytical manpower/equipment demand from verified historical features.

cost_overrun_risk_prediction.description: Estimate cost-overrun risk; does not replace approved cost-control calculations.

productivity_prediction.description: Predict productivity from verified quantities/resource inputs.

risk_prioritization.description: Prioritize risk classes from available verified risk features.

procurement_delay_risk.description: Estimate procurement delay risk from verified procurement history.

progress_slippage_prediction.description: Estimate progress-slippage risk from verified period/status data.
